item.title: Ex CIA chief Brennan and ex-FBI officials Strzok, Page subpoenaed by Florida grand jury investigating Trump-Russia probe origins
item.description: Former CIA Director John Brennan, alongside ex-FBI officials Peter Strzok and Lisa Page, have been subpoenaed by a Florida grand jury investigating the Trump-Russia probe's origins. This development follows scrutiny over anti-Trump texts exchanged between Strzok and Page, who were part of Special Counsel Mueller's team. Up to 30 subpoenas are expected.

'No US government official will attend’: Trump to boycott G20 in Johannesburg, calls event in South Africa a ‘total disgrace’
item.description: US President Donald Trump declared no American officials would attend the upcoming G20 summit in South Africa, citing alleged mistreatment of white farmers and calling it a "total disgrace." Trump accused the South African government of human rights abuses and illegal land confiscation. He plans to host the 2026 G20 in Miami, Florida.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: What happened to Jimmy Kimmel? Live show cancelled at last minute with no explanation
item.description: Viewers expecting a new Jimmy Kimmel Live! episode on Thursday were met with a rerun, leaving many confused. Singer Madison Beer confirmed her appearance was rescheduled due to unforeseen circumstances, while the show and network remained silent. This marks the first unplanned schedule change since Kimmel's September on-air apology.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: After Labubus: Why are people camping outside Starbucks and fighting over the 'Bearista Cup?
item.description: Starbucks’ new 20-ounce Bearista glass cup, shaped like a teddy bear in a green beanie, has sparked chaos across stores, with fans camping out, brawling in Houston, and resellers charging up to US$300. The frenzy forced Starbucks to apologise for limited stock, proving that in the age of drop culture, even coffee can cause commotion.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Green Card lottery 2027: US announces changes in entry process, start date to be announced
item.description: The US State Department has announced delays and changes to the Green Card lottery, DV-2027. Officials warn against fraudulent claims about the registration period being open, emphasizing that official dates will be announced soon. This program offers permanent residency to individuals from low-immigration countries, with specific eligibility criteria and annual visa limits.

item.title: Middle East unrest: Turkey issues genocide arrest warrant against Netnayahu; Istanbul prosecutor lists 37 officials
item.description: Turkey has issued arrest warrants for Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and 36 other senior government officials, accusing them of genocide. The charges stem from the ongoing conflict and humanitarian crisis in Gaza, which has significantly heightened tensions between the two nations.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Salik launches Eid Al Etihad quiz with AED 400 prizes for participants
item.description: Dubai’s Salik has launched a four-week quiz to mark the UAE’s 54th Eid Al Etihad, offering participants the chance to win two recharge cards worth AED 400 each. One question will be released weekly until 2 December, though the platform remains unconfirmed. The initiative forms part of the broader National Month celebrations across the UAE.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Non-Saudis can own real estate in Saudi Arabia from January 2026
item.description: Saudi Arabia will allow non-Saudis to own real estate starting January 2026, according to an official document obtained and reviewed by Okaz. The new law sets ownership categories, fees, and penalties, while restricting property in Makkah and Madinah to Muslims and Saudi companies. Specific documents and designated ownership zones will be disclosed by the Real Estate General Authority
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Mamdani’s rise throws up immigrants fear vs affordability crisis debate in MAGA world
item.description: New York City's political landscape is electrified by Zohran Mamdani's stunning mayoral victory, sparking contrasting reactions from MAGA supporters and progressives. While some fear a leftist takeover, others see Mamdani's win as a catalyst for addressing affordability, a theme even Donald Trump is now acknowledging, signaling a potential shift in political discourse.
item.dc:creator: Chidanand Rajghatta

item.title: US visa likely to be denied to applicants with diabetes, obesity, chronic illness under new Trump rule
item.description: New US visa directives reportedly require applicants to undergo health screenings for chronic conditions like diabetes and obesity. Officials will assess if individuals might become a public charge due to medical needs or age, potentially impacting their eligibility for entry. This expands previous health checks beyond communicable diseases.

item.title: 'Vivek must lose': MAGA wants Ramaswamy to lose Ohio election after Mamdani's NYC win; 'Not a race between...'
item.description: A recent outlier poll suggesting Democrat Amy Acton leads Republican Vivek Ramaswamy in the 2026 Ohio Governor race has ignited backlash within MAGA circles. Critics are demanding Ramaswamy's replacement, citing recent GOP losses and his advice to shun identity politics, with some expressing xenophobic sentiments.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Canada tightens visa cancellation rules, foreign workers, international students and visitors face heightened scrutiny
item.description: Canada has updated immigration guidelines, empowering officers to cancel already-issued visitor visas, study permits, and work permits. This shift emphasizes ongoing compliance with immigration conditions, impacting international students and frequent visitors. The changes aim to strengthen oversight and prevent program misuse.
item.dc:creator: Lubna Kably

item.title: All knew they were chatting with minor: 8 men, many Indian-origin, arrested in Canada sex sting operation
item.description: Eight men have been arrested in an undercover sting operation by the London Police in Canada's Ontario. The operation, conducted on an online platform, involved an undercover officer posing as a minor. The accused, aged 22 to 34, face charges of communicating to obtain sexual services from someone believed to be under 18.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: 'Don't lecture about Indian literacy rates': American CEO James Fishback's jibe at Vivek Ramaswamy
item.description: "We don't want ANYONE lecturing us about Indian literacy rates or Chinese math rates. Cut the crap now. We’re Americans. We’re talented. We’re smart. And no, we’re not giving up church on Sunday for more math tutoring. We’re not skipping Friday Night Lights because there’s a chemistry test to cram for. The second we stop apologizing for who we are, we will start winning again!" Fishback said.
item.dc:creator: TOI World Desk

item.title: Kuwaiti authorities detain Actress pending investigation over controversial audio clip
item.description: A Kuwaiti actress has been detained for 21 days as authorities investigate a state security case linked to a controversial audio recording deemed “offensive.” While her name has not been officially disclosed, several news outlets, including Al-Qabas newspaper, have identified her as Elham Al-Fadala. The Public Prosecution is conducting a forensic examination to determine the recording’s authenticity, amid divided public reactions.
